segments.title: 2026's word, picked because of AI?
segments.say: A dictionary picked one word for this year, because of AI. Which? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It's HUMAN!
segments.say: It's human! Cambridge Dictionary's Word of the Year.

segments.title: Why? AI blurs the line
segments.say: AI is blurring the line between people and machines.

segments.title: Collins picked 'mogging'
segments.say: Collins went with mogging. Its use jumped two hundred ten percent.
